verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a live, well-formed llms.txt at docs.runpod.io/llms.txt. Doc pages are served as raw .md, and Runpod publishes agent-oriented guides for agent skills and its MCP servers, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-corpus export, and no independent community reports of agents successfully using these docs.
